description:
The image depicts a street sign and traffic light against a backdrop of trees and a blue sky.

* A street sign
	+ The sign is white with black text that reads "MASONIC" in large letters.
	+ Below the main text, there is smaller text that reads "900".
	+ The sign is attached to a metal pole and is angled slightly to the right.
* A traffic light
	+ The traffic light is located above the street sign and is partially obscured by it
